verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing documents its own testing capability to simulate purchases before going live, so sandbox simulation of authorizations exists as a first-party feature. The evidence does not show that the full lifecycle can be simulated. Missing for 10: documented simulation of clearings/captures, reversals, refunds, and declines; testing against real-time authorization webhook decisioning; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can simulate the whole transaction lifecycle in the sandbox — authorizations, clearings, reversals, refunds, and declines — so my auth logic is tested before a real card ever swipes

citations.quote: Test the integration: Simulate test purchases before going live.
Learn how to test your integration and simulate purchases.
